micah: FYI hitting puzzling behavior in sample app: when uploading from an InputStream RequestBody on the emulator, backend sometimes receives duplicate POSTs. Works fine on device.
tess: Which OkHttp/Retrofit versions? Any retries enabled?
micah: Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.9.3. Default OkHttp client in sample (retryOnConnectionFailure=true). No explicit retry logic.
jon: OkHttp will retry on connection failures if it thinks it can safely replay the body. Streaming InputStream bodies are non-replayable; but if the stream errors mid-flight and connection is retried at a lower level, server can receive a partial then a full POST depending on how proxies behave. That can look like duplicates.
tess: Can you reproduce with an HTTP/2 server that injects RST_STREAM on first attempt?
micah: Yes - with a local test proxy that resets streams, first request gets a stream reset, then OkHttp issues a second attempt and backend shows a second POST ~250ms later.
jon: Quick mitigations: 1) set client.retryOnConnectionFailure(false) in the sample, 2) change sample upload to buffer (File or byte[]) so the client can safely retry. For SDK/quickstart docs we should explain tradeoffs rather than defaulting to disabling retries.
tess: Agreed. Suggest adding a small helper in our sample: `fun makeReplayableRequestBody(input: InputStream): RequestBody` which buffers small uploads (under 10MB) and streams large ones with explicit guidance. Also add an onboarding note: "On emulator/flaky networks, non-rewindable streaming bodies + automatic retries can cause duplicates; prefer buffered bodies or disable automatic retries for non-idempotent endpoints."
micah: I'll open a PR with: sample change to buffered upload for the simple tutorial, a README paragraph, and a tiny CI test that simulates stream resets to catch regressions.
devex-bot: Created DEVEX-4401 "duplicate POSTs from non-replayable streaming uploads on emulator" assigned to micah
micah: Adding repro steps to the PR: Pixel 4 emulator API 30, OkHttp 4.9.3, local proxy that sends RST_STREAM on first connection, upload a 5MB stream. Observe duplicate POSTs in backend logs.
tess: Nice. Also add a short code snippet showing how to disable retries per-call with a custom client if caller prefers.
micah: Will do, will include logs and test harness.
